HAROON'S CLAW [Version 1.0]
TigerWareHouse / Global Exports Media – 2025
Note: This product does NOT encourage animal violence. It is purely a work of fiction.
Story:
Saladin wakes up in his apartment to find the front door open—his cat Haroon has slipped out again.
"Haroon! Haroon!" he shouts, calling to his precious feline friend.
Click to expand...
Outside, he sees her hissing at another street cat. He tries to stop the fight, but Haroon runs off, deep into her turf wars. Determined not to face his mama’s wrath, Saladin vows to bring Haroon back before she causes more chaos.
Gameplay Goal:
You play as Saladin, chasing after Haroon. Each time you find her, you switch to controlling Haroon in a 1-on-1 cat battle.
First, outside in the street
Then inside the apartment
Then again at night outside
Finally, in the alleyway for a climactic showdown… against her twin lookalike
Backstory (Spoilers):
Nobody asked, but here it is:
This all started with my fluffy cat constantly interrupting me while working on my PC. One night, she ran out the door and stared down another cat on the porch. That moment sparked this ridiculous idea — what if my cat thought she was in a turf war?
Three days later, after taking real photos and slapping them into RPG Maker XP, I built a 4-map mini-game.
All visuals, music, and sound were handmade by me using:
Samsung Cellphone
️ MS Paint & Photopea
WavePad
Google Gemini (for some AI support)
Made in 2 days. Very ghetto. Very handmade. Very fast.
It’s my first completed project. It’s weird. It’s heartfelt. It’s spaghetti.
Tools Used:
RPG Maker XP
Samsung Cellphone
MS Paint
Photopea
Google Gemini
WavePad
Side Note:
If you’re a developer, modder, or game designer and you see potential for improvements, mods, or collabs — hit me up. This is free shareware and part of my demo portfolio.
